When you buy a widget at a retailer using your Goatmaster 5000 Visa card, Visa charges the merchant a fee for processing the transaction - typically in the 1-3% range. So if you pay your card off every month, it costs you nothing, but costs the retailer a little. Granted, handling cash has its own costs for retailers (preventing theft, armored cars, etc).

A lot of people also choose not to pay off their credit cards every month, which costs them very high interest.

If you pay your card off every month in full, always use your CC for purchases so you can take advantage of cashback and other rewards.
